verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP capability list says it can "Search emails with custom queries" and "Filter emails by labels", so it has a documented search and filter capability. That is only a one-line prose mention with no detail on query syntax, operators, ranking or coverage of the full mailbox. A separate note about storing mail in Durable Objects and R2 to "speed things up" hints at speed but does not describe search. missing for 10: documented search operators/syntax, ranked or relevance-ordered results, evidence of search across full mail history, any in-app (non-MCP) search documentation, hands-on corroboration of search speed and precision.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Search emails with custom queries - Filter emails by labels
We're now storing the user's emails in their Durable Object & an R2 bucket. This allow us to speed things up, a lot.
